parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the toggle or actuator part of the wall switch, made of ABS plastic. It is small and protrudes from the base body, allowing manual operation.
parts.Functional_description: The switch serves as the user interface for turning an electrical circuit on or off. It transmits mechanical motion to internal contacts to complete or break the circuit.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or pivotally between two stable positions (on/off) when pressed or flipped by the user.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main housing or mounting plate of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate plastic. It provides structural support and insulation.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the switch mechanism and electrical contacts in place, ensuring safety and stability when mounted on a wall.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or electrical box, providing a stable base for the moving switch component.
